publication_decision.label_arrays: Two NPZ label packages and two CSV equivalents are withheld from the current public file set. Their arrays, masks, hashes, and original source files are preserved externally. Three public summary-table editions also omit the mean_endpoint input column: the two condition-label coverage tables and the endpoint-condition audit. Their remaining scientific fields are unchanged; complete originals and source hashes remain external.
publication_decision.mini_payload: The transformed neural/behavioral replay bundle remains external. Source, exporter, and explicit no-payload behavior remain available.
publication_decision.sensorium_model_payloads: Eight trained-model, GPFA, and preprocessing files are withheld conservatively pending a documented redistribution basis. Historical file identities remain in results/manifests/model_files.csv.
publication_decision.scientific_results: Aggregate evaluation tables, scientific reports, figures, configurations, and source identities remain available. Retention does not grant a blanket license to underlying data or determine the legal classification of every numerical derivative.
publication_decision.legal_classification: No conclusion is asserted that trained weights or every numerical transformation are legally adapted material. The hold records unresolved publication prerequisites.
publication_decision.execution_consequences: A source-only clone can inspect results, aggregate saved scores, and run synthetic checks. Label-dependent rendering, numerical mini replay, and trained-model inference need appropriately obtained external payloads.
publication_decision.history: Exclusion from the proposed latest tree does not remove previous Git or LFS objects, forks, caches, or clones.
